table_row: Endpoint clocks cannot be reconciled | Do not derive timestamp order or contact
narrative: Strict precedence and temporal contact are both defined over compatible clocks. If A's end and B's start are recorded against clocks that cannot be reconciled to a common reference (for example, an unresolved timezone on one side, or two patient-local clocks with no established offset), neither precedes nor meets may be derived from the raw timestamps; the correct outcome is an explicit failure to compare, not a default ordering.

illustrative_expectation.basis: A's endpoint has no resolved offset against B's UTC anchor; existing PS-006 rejects unresolved timezones at ingestion, and this scenario extends the same discipline to precedence/contact comparisons

unresolved_before_adoption: whether INCOMPARABLE_CLOCKS reuses the existing INCOMPARABLE status from interval-cohort-1.0/bounded-interval-1.0 or needs a distinct name scoped to precedence
